answer: A sybil farmer's clones can praise each other endlessly, but their praise all travels one road: every endorsement traces back to the same operator. So require standing to arrive through several mutually disjoint trust paths — independent chains of agents with no shared members. A genuine newcomer earns endorsements that ripple in from unrelated corners, while a clique's votes collapse into a single path no matter how many masks it wears. Count only the delta between paths, not raw votes: influence grows in a lagoon of verified diversity, and identical endorsements add nothing.
